title: Fuel Link
description: Shares the fuel left (litres) and the range with your own phone over your tailnet, read-only, for the Shell diesel page. Runs in the background, with no tile in the apps menu.

config._comment: port: the read-only JSON at /fuel (and /go, a redirect back to the page with the reading), on the head unit's loopback and its tailnet address only. allowOrigin: the page allowed to read it, and the only place /go sends you back to. nice: 19, the lowest CPU priority (kit/runtime/priority.js): CarPlay and the HMI go first.
